izzyondroid:com.zell_mbc.publicartexplor.name: PublicArtExplorer
izzyondroid:com.zell_mbc.publicartexplor.description:
Have you ever found yourself standing before a piece of outdoor art, curious about its story? Or arrived in a new place wondering if there’s any outdoor artwork waiting to be discovered nearby?
 PublicArtExplorer allows you to discover and explore public art around you in just two clicks. The app uses your location to instantly reveal nearby sculptures, murals, and installations, complete with detailed information about each piece and its artist.
 PublicArtExplorer’s data is based on the open platforms OpenStreetMap and Wikipedia. Because these platforms are built and maintained by a global community of volunteers, anyone can contribute: if you notice missing details or discover new artworks, you’re encouraged to add or update information directly on OpenStreetMap or Wikipedia. This collective approach means that every contribution helps to improve the app for all users, fostering a shared, up-to-date resource that benefits everyone interested in public art.
 Key features
 Show what's around and offer to show the details for each artwork.
 Aimed at providing low barrier access to public art as well as instigiating people to add missing information to OSM and Wikipedia for the benefit of others.
 Web site
 https://publicartexplorer.com/

izzyondroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_upl.name: Paperless NGX Uploader
izzyondroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_upl.summary: Upload documents to a Paperless-NGX server using the native share intent
izzyondroid:net.gmartin.paperlessngx_upl.description:
Paperless‑NGX Uploader uploads single or multiple documents to Paperless‑NGX directly from the system Share menu. This project updates and adapts the original “Paperless Share” by qcasey to modern Android versions while keeping the same simple “share and upload” workflow.
 Features: 
 Android native Share Intent integration (one action = one file).
 Paperless‑NGX server configuration (URL), username and password.
 Secure credential storage with automatic recovery on startup.
 Connection test with feedback (success, invalid credentials, unreachable host).
 Tag management: Fetches tags from Paperless‑NGX after a valid connection.
 Tag selection dialog with search/filter.
 Option to set default tags for uploads.
 Selected tags are persisted and restored on startup.
 Uploads the shared document with the configured/default tags.
 Upload status indicator; on failure, a Snackbar notifies the user.
 On success, the app returns to background.

izzyondroid:vadimerenkov.aucards.name: Aucards
izzyondroid:vadimerenkov.aucards.summary: Create reusable cards for quick access when non-verbal communication is needed.
izzyondroid:vadimerenkov.aucards.description:
Aucards is a free and open-source app where you can create colorful communication cards to help you communicate with others.
 App is based on the concept of "autistic cards", which people with special needs use to quickly communicate their feelings, their requests or inform others of their conditions.
 If you've ever experienced the need to say something when you couldn't, for example, in a moment of autistic shutdown, when you are too overwhelmed to speak, then this app is for you. It is designed to be as frictionless as possible to minimize the effort needed to express what you feel right now.
 Highlights: 
 Create an endless amount of cards with unique messages
 Choose any color from a rich palette – or create your own!
 Organize your cards however you like: drag them around or add to favourites
 Easy to use: just tap on the card to open it in fullscreen!
 Bring your cards to any device: easily export and transfer them wherever you like
 Play a sound to let others know you want to say something
 Completely free, open source and no ads – ever!
 Who can benefit from this app: 
 People with autism/adhd
 Children who have difficulties with verbal communication
 Elderly people who need assistance
 Or anyone in a situation where you can't speak: on a loud concert or a lecture!

fdroid:com.akylas.enforcedoze.name: EnforceDoze
fdroid:com.akylas.enforcedoze.summary: Enable Doze mode immediately after screen off and turn off motion sensing
fdroid:com.akylas.enforcedoze.description:
**EnforceDoze** allows you to forcefully enable Doze right after you turn off your
screen, and on top of that, it also disables motion sensors so Doze stays active
even if your device is not stationary while screen off. Doze will only deactivate
periodically to execute maintenance jobs (like getting notifications, etc),
otherwise it will remain active as long as your screen is off. This brings a lot
more battery savings than standard Doze functionality, because even with screen
off and Doze enabled, Doze is still periodically checking for movement, and
disabling motion sensing improves battery life further.
**Features**
* Force Doze mode immediately after screen off or after a user specified delay
* Add/remove apps or packages directly to system Doze whitelist
* Disable motion sensors to prevent Doze from kicking in during movement
* Tasker support to turn on/off EnforceDoze and modify other features
* Disable WiFi and mobile data completely during Doze
* Ignore disabling Wifi/Data if music is playing
* Ignore disabling Wifi/Data if hotspot is enabled
* Enable Doze mode on devices where OEM has disabled it
* No root mode so you can enjoy the core benefits without rooting your device

fdroid:com.baldo.bob.summary: Baby on Board is an application of pregnancy tracking that respect your privacy
fdroid:com.baldo.bob.description:

fdroid:com.jerboa.description:

Lemmy is similar to sites like Reddit, Lobste.rs, or Hacker News: you subscribe to forums you're interested in, post links and discussions, then vote, and comment on them. Behind the scenes, it is very different; anyone can easily run a server, and all these servers are federated (think email), and connected to the same universe, called the Fediverse.

fdroid:com.rastislavkish.vscan.name: VScan
fdroid:com.rastislavkish.vscan.summary: A visual perception layer for the blind
fdroid:com.rastislavkish.vscan.description:
This is a little project of mine aiming to research how vision LLMs could help out blind people on travel and in their every-day life by substituting eyesight for various visual tasks. VScan turns your smartphone's camera into a device for visual perception. You can define various optical cognitive functions, like looking for objects, signs, evaluating a scene or simply mediating visual impressions. You can afterwards use these functions on the camera view, just like a sighted person would use their eyes to achieve a specific goal in the physical world.
Each cognitive tool consists of two major parts:
• The camera to be used - front / back, as well as camera parameters - resolution, flashlight etc.
• The prompts used for LLM processing. LLM is the bridge between raw pixel data and your interpretation of it, and in the user/system prompt, you can specify what exactly are you interested in for the particular function and how should it be communicated, as well as the LLM model that should be used.
Camera input in combination with an LLM processing prompt forms a cognitive function, which can be used to serve various visual tasks.
VScan is open-source software. Visit the project's official repository to learn more about its background, motivation, specific usage examples and setup instructions.

fdroid:com.slate.launcher.name: Slate
fdroid:com.slate.launcher.summary: Minimal text-only Android home screen. No icons. No analytics. Zero network.
fdroid:com.slate.launcher.description:
Slate is a minimal text-only Android home screen built for focus.
Most launchers want to keep you on your phone. Colourful icons trigger recognition without thought, notification badges create artificial urgency, and recommendation widgets are optimised for engagement, not intent. Slate removes all of that. Apps are presented as plain text, the same way a to-do list presents tasks. You open the app you meant to open, not the one that looked most appealing.
APPEARANCE
* Two homescreen layouts: Flow (apps wrap like text, sized by usage) or Minimal List (one app per line with optional alphabetical fast-scroll)
* Fully customisable background and text colours with a live colour picker
* Follow system theme: switches automatically with system dark mode
* Apply background colour to the lockscreen for a uniform look
* Per-app colour overrides to highlight what matters
* Notification highlight: app names change colour when an app has a pending notification
* Typography control: font family (Google Fonts plus import your own), weight, line spacing, word spacing
* Font size scales with usage in Flow view
INTERACTION
* Swipe up to search apps
* Configurable single-finger swipe gestures (any app, notifications, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, location, camera, more)
* Double-tap to lock screen (via accessibility service)
* Long-press an app to pin, hide, rename, recolour, uninstall, or move to a folder
* Pin apps to the top regardless of sort order
* Sort alphabetically or by most used
* Custom folders: each folder is a text label with a marker (chevron, slash, bullet, brackets, count, or plain). Tap to expand inline. Long-press to rename, recolour, or delete
QUICK TOGGLES STRIP
An optional row of text widgets at the top or bottom of your home screen. Choose from Clock, Date, Next alarm, Battery percent, Charging, Time to full, Battery temperature, Uptime, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Mobile data, Airplane mode, DND, Volume, Ringer mode, Torch, Brightness, Location, NFC, and contact tap-to-call or tap-to-text shortcuts. Off by default. Pick widgets, position, and typography from Settings.
CONTROL
* Lock orientation to portrait
* Optional persistent search bar on the home screen
* Optional contact search: turn it on to surface contacts inline with apps when you type. Read at search time, never stored. Google-only sub-toggle skips duplicates from WhatsApp, Telegram, SIM
* PIN-lock the hidden apps list (4 to 8 digits, PBKDF2 hashed) with optional biometric unlock. Hidden-app launches stay out of Android Recents, with an opt-out
* Work-profile apps are listed too, marked with the profile name and grouped into a folder on first sight
* Export and import all settings as a JSON backup. Hidden-apps list and PIN are omitted by default. Opt in via Settings, with an in-memory PIN check on import
PRIVACY
Slate does not collect, transmit, or share any data. No analytics, no crash reporting, no network activity. All preferences are stored locally. App usage counts never leave the device. Each Android permission Slate declares is requested only for the specific feature that uses it. Full details in the in-app privacy policy.
OPEN SOURCE
MIT licensed. Source at github.com/roufsyed/Slate-Minimal-Launcher

fdroid:com.sleeptimer.name: SleepTimer
fdroid:com.sleeptimer.summary: Timer, which activates the devices standby mode
fdroid:com.sleeptimer.description:
SleepTimer is a timer, like the ones in TVs an Hifi systems. After a specified time the devices
standby mode is activated, as if the power button was shortly touched. It doesn't matter if a video
or audio stream is played or another app tries to prevent the standby mode.
Reactivating is possible by a short press of the power button.
Features:
- permanent notification showing the remaining time until standby
- possibility to use Androids quick settings for pausing and resuming a countdown

fdroid:com.yourname.pdftoolkit.name: PDF Toolkit
fdroid:com.yourname.pdftoolkit.summary: All-in-one PDF and image toolkit for Android
fdroid:com.yourname.pdftoolkit.description:
PDF Toolkit is a comprehensive PDF and image manipulation tool for Android.
Features include:
* Merge multiple PDFs into one
* Split PDF into multiple files
* Compress PDF to reduce file size
* Convert PDF pages to images
* Convert images to PDF
* Reorder, rotate, and delete PDF pages
* Extract specific pages from PDF
* Add watermarks and page numbers
* Password protect PDFs (lock/unlock)
* Sign PDFs with digital signatures
* OCR using Tesseract (open source)
* Scan documents to PDF using camera
* Extract text from PDFs
* View and edit PDF metadata
* Image tools (compress, resize, convert formats)
The F-Droid version uses Tesseract OCR instead of Google ML Kit
to maintain compatibility with F-Droid's free software requirements.

fdroid:de.anderdonau.hackersdiet.name: Hacker's Diet Offline
fdroid:de.anderdonau.hackersdiet.summary: This is an offline version of the Hackers Diet Online.
fdroid:de.anderdonau.hackersdiet.description:
The Hacker's Diet, published by John Walker, founder of Autodesk, Inc, and co-author of AutoCAD, as a handy Android app. You can track your weight and excercise and get a weighted moving average of your weight's change over time.
The app can be used completely offline, with local backups being created as well. You can also optionally synchronise your weight to the Hacker's Diet Online at https://www.fourmilab.ch/cgi-bin/HackDiet which has additional features like weight gain/loss goals, Trend calculations, graphs over long periods and more.

fdroid:de.neuwirthinformatik.alexander.a.name: ArcheryStats
fdroid:de.neuwirthinformatik.alexander.a.description:
This app lets you save your archery scores in blocks of six.

fdroid:de.retujo.bierverkostung.name: Bierverkostung
fdroid:de.retujo.bierverkostung.summary: Document and manage your personal beer tastings
fdroid:de.retujo.bierverkostung.description:
Developed by a beer sommelier, this app allows for managing your personal beer
tastings. Its functionality comprises the addition, changing and, if necessary,
the deletion of
* beers,
* breweries,
* beer styles and of course
* tastings.
Besides the database can be exported and imported as a whole This makes it
possible to easily migrate the application to another phone. All data resides
locally on the phone. An internet connection is thus not required.

fdroid:fr.pierre.chiffreslettres.name: Numbers & Letters
fdroid:fr.pierre.chiffreslettres.summary: Mental arithmetic and vocabulary game, no ads, no trackers
fdroid:fr.pierre.chiffreslettres.description:
Numbers & Letters is a mental arithmetic and vocabulary game, in the spirit of the well-known French TV game show of the same principle, with no affiliation to it.
Two game modes:
* Numbers: 6 numbers are drawn along with a target to reach. Build your calculation step by step, calculator-style, combining the numbers with the 4 basic operations.
* Letters: 10 letters are drawn. Find the longest possible word using these letters before time runs out.
Several ways to play:
* Solo game, with 4 levels of increasing difficulty (Emile, Nestor, Monique, Mathieu), alternating numbers and letters rounds.
* Duo game, for two players on the same phone, with a Duo mode (each keeps their own score) or a Head-to-head mode (only one winner per round).
* Network game, the same duo game but on two separate phones, connected over Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
* Daily challenge, with a randomly drawn goal each day and trophies for streaks of successful days.
* Streak, timed, words and no-mistake challenges, to progress at your own pace.
* Free training mode, with no time limit and no round limit.
The app keeps track of your statistics and rewards your progress with trophies, offers a light or dark theme, and works entirely offline: no ads, no trackers, no network connection required (except to play a network game).
Free and open source software under the GNU GPL-3.0 license.

fdroid:io.github.samcrow.jrbpsurvey.name: JRBP Survey
fdroid:io.github.samcrow.jrbpsurvey.summary: Jasper Ridge ant survey navigation and data entry
fdroid:io.github.samcrow.jrbpsurvey.description:
The Jasper Ridge Biological Preserve ant survey regularly surveys the species of ants in each of
hundreds of locations across the preserve. This application helps people navigate to the correct
locations, identify ants, record observations, and upload them to a central database.
Note: This application is intended only for registered volunteers participating in the ant survey.
For more information about the ant survey, see https://jrbp.stanford.edu/research/jrbp-ant-survey .

fdroid:io.privkey.keep.name: Keep: FROST Nostr Signer
fdroid:io.privkey.keep.summary: FROST threshold signer and Nostr event signer for Android
fdroid:io.privkey.keep.description:
Keep is a FROST (Flexible Round-Optimized Schnorr Threshold Signatures) threshold signing app and dedicated Nostr event signer for Android. It lets you hold FROST key shares on your phone and sign Nostr events without any single device ever holding the full private key.
Keep implements the NIP-55 Android Signer protocol and NIP-46 remote signing, so any compatible Nostr client can request signatures directly.
Features:
- FROST threshold signing (2-of-3, 3-of-5, etc.)
- NIP-55 Android Signer protocol
- NIP-46 remote signing (bunker service)
- Import and export FROST shares via QR code or text
- Multiple account support
- Per-app signing permissions and policies
- Biometric and PIN authentication
- Hardware-backed key storage (Android Keystore)
- NIP-44 encryption and decryption
- SOCKS proxy support (Tor)
- Encrypted backup and restore

flathub:io.github.vipaol.mobapp-game.summary: Minimalist physics arcade: speed, flips, built-in editor
flathub:io.github.vipaol.mobapp-game.description:
A cross-platform minimalist arcade game powered by Emini physics engine. Android, desktop Java,
 and J2ME are supported.
 Two game modes:
 Endless mode: the track is procedurally generated on the fly, randomly connecting various
 structures (both built-in and custom).
 Levels: completely predefined tracks with obstacles, where the main goal is to reach the
 finish plate.
 Built-in editor: The game offers complete creative freedom. You can create your own levels and
 structure blocks for endless mode.
 Examples: The editor allows you to open the game's built-in structures and levels - they are
 highlighted and displayed at the end. Built-in structures can be overridden by naming a custom
 one with the same name (don't forget to load the structures from the main menu).
 Tools for creating tracks of any difficulty:
 Surfaces: Lines, Circles (arcs with adjustable radius and scaling), and Sinusoids for smooth
 transitions.
 Interactive Platforms: Trampolines with adjustable springiness, deadly "Lava", and "Broken
 Lines" (falling slabs).
 Accelerators: Plates that change the engine's power and direction (can also slow down).
 Physics Bodies: Round and Square physical entities. Adjust their mass, friction, elasticity,
 gravity, color, fall timers, or turn them into moving lava!
 Auxiliary elements: Finish, Spawn points, and "Link" (copies another element with an offset).

 Its main focus, in fact, is on music management.
 Features:
 Collection list and multiple user defined playlists

flathub:org.mosh.mosh.name: Mosh
flathub:org.mosh.mosh.developer: Keith Winstein, John Hood, et al.
flathub:org.mosh.mosh.description:
Mosh is a remote terminal application that supports intermittent
 connectivity, allows roaming, and provides speculative local echo
 and line editing of user keystrokes.
 It aims to support the typical interactive uses of SSH, plus:
 Mosh keeps the session alive if the client goes to sleep and
 wakes up later, or temporarily loses its Internet connection.
 Mosh allows the client and server to "roam" and change IP
 addresses, while keeping the connection alive. Unlike SSH, Mosh
 can be used while switching between Wi-Fi networks or from Wi-Fi
 to cellular data to wired Ethernet.
 The Mosh client runs a predictive model of the server's behavior
 in the background and tries to guess intelligently how each
 keystroke will affect the screen state. When it is confident in
 its predictions, it will show them to the user while waiting for
 confirmation from the server. Most typing and uses of the left-
 and right-arrow keys can be echoed immediately.
 As a result, Mosh is usable on high-latency links, e.g. on a
 cellular data connection or spotty Wi-Fi. In distinction from
 previous attempts at local echo modes in other protocols, Mosh
 works properly with full-screen applications such as emacs, vi,
 alpine, and irssi, and automatically recovers from occasional
 prediction errors within an RTT. On high-latency links, Mosh
 underlines its predictions while they are outstanding and removes
 the underline when they are confirmed by the server.
 Mosh does not support X forwarding or the non-interactive uses of SSH,
 including port forwarding.

A cross-platform ship-borne GUI navigation application made

 available charts. The application is configurable with user
 icon. The core supports:
 GPS/GPSD Position Input and Display
 BSB Raster Chart display 
 S57 Vector ENC and CM93 chart display 
 AIS Input Decoding and Display
 Waypoint Autopilot Navigation 
 Plugin support includes wheather, tactical, annotations and tidal data.
 Pilot charts can be downloaded from project website at opencpn.org.
 Other useful add-ons may be found inside the "Download" link at
 at the same site.

flathub:org.scilab.Scilab.name: Scilab
flathub:org.scilab.Scilab.summary: Scientific software package for numerical computations
flathub:org.scilab.Scilab.description:
Scilab is free and open source software for numerical computation providing a powerful computing
 environment for engineering and scientific applications. Scilab includes hundreds of mathematical
 functions. It has a high level programming language allowing access to advanced data structures,
 2-D and 3-D graphical functions. A large number of functionalities is included in Scilab:
 Maths & Simulation: For usual engineering and science applications
 2-D & 3-D Visualization: Graphics functions to visualize, annotate and export data
 Optimization: Algorithms to solve constrained and unconstrained continuous and discrete problems
 Statistics: Tools to perform data analysis and modeling
 Control System Design & Analysis: Standard algorithms and tools for control system study
 Signal Processing: Visualize, analyze and filter signals in time and frequency domains
 Application Development: Increase Scilab native functionalities and manage data exchanges
 Xcos - Hybrid dynamic systems modeler and simulator: Modeling physical systems, control systems
 Thanks to its ability to interconnect with third-party technologies and applications, Scilab
 can also act as a unique platform to bring together codes written in different programming languages
 in a single, unified language, thus facilitating their distribution, their back-up and use.

fedora-packages:apbs/apbs.name: apbs
fedora-packages:apbs/apbs.description: APBS is a software package for the numerical solution of the Poisson-Boltzmann equation (PBE), one of the most popular continuum models for describing electrostatic interactions between molecular solutes in salty, aqueous media. APBS was designed to efficiently evaluate electrostatic properties for such simulations for a wide range of length scales to enable the investigation of molecules with tens to millions of atoms. It is also widely used in molecular visualization (in such applications as PyMOL).

fedora-packages:bcrypt/bcrypt.name: bcrypt
fedora-packages:bcrypt/bcrypt.description: Bcrypt is a cross platform file encryption utility. Encrypted files are portable across all supported operating systems and processors. Passphrases must be between 8 and 56 characters and are hashed internally to a 448 bit key. However, all characters supplied are significant. The stronger your passphrase, the more secure your data. In addition to encrypting your data, bcrypt will by default overwrite the original input file with random garbage three times before deleting it in order to thwart data recovery attempts by persons who may gain access to your computer. Bcrypt uses the blowfish encryption algorithm published by Bruce Schneier in 1993.

Secondary objective is to make it possible to explore atmospheric effects such as glories, fogbows etc., as well as simulate unusual environments such as on Mars or an exoplanet orbiting a star with a non-solar spectrum of radiation. It can rpmbuild packages, dnf/yum install their dependencies, prep packages, and install them. There are commands to list package dependencies and missing dependencies. The diff command compares the current spec file with a freshly generated one, the update command updates the spec file to latest version from Stackage or Hackage, and the refresh command updates the spec file to the current cabal-rpm packaging. It also handles Hackage revisions of packages. Standalone packages can also be made, built with cabal-install.

bluejetty:00016404:ios.name: Flick Baseball Super Homerun
bluejetty:00016404:ios.summary: Step up to the plate for an unrivaled baseball experience with **Flick Baseball Super Homerun**! This game redefines the essence of baseball with its innovative one flick easy control, ensuring that players of all skill levels can dive righ
bluejetty:00016404:ios.description:
Step up to the plate for an unrivaled baseball experience with **Flick Baseball Super Homerun**! This game redefines the essence of baseball with its innovative one flick easy control, ensuring that players of all skill levels can dive right into the action without a steep learning curve. Prepare to immerse yourself in a "real-life like" batting simulation that brings the excitement of the ballpark straight to your fingertips.
**Key Features:**
- **One Swipe Control**: Simplify your gameplay with just a flick! The intuitive control system means your focus is solely on timing and precision, making every hit satisfying.
- **Diverse Arsenal of Balls**: Face off against more than 9 different exciting balls, each with unique behaviors. From curveballs to sliders, every pitch is a new challenge.
- **Powerful Bats Collection**: Swing for the stars with over 9 powerful bats. Unlock these bats to increase your chances of sending the ball into orbit.
- **Atmospheric Environments**: Play in stunning environments that make you feel right at home. Whether it's the roar of the crowd or the chill of the night games, each setting adds to the immersive experience.
- **Endless Levels**: With unlimited levels to conquer, your journey to becoming a home-run legend is endless. Challenge yourself to surpass your high scores and climb the ranks.
- **Dynamic Ball Movement**: Experience the unpredictability of baseball with various pitches that bring the ball to life. Anticipate the pendulum movements and time your swing perfectly to hit that sweet spot.
**Baseball Tips:**
- **Coin Rewards**: Earn coins by hitting home runs and use them to unlock powerful and awesome bats, enhancing your gameplay.
- **Master the Swing**: Pay attention to the thrown pattern and adapt your swing for an accurate hit. Timing is everything in Flick Baseball Super Homerun.
- **Bonus for Distance**: Achieve maximum distance with your hits and get rewarded with double health, pushing you further in your quest for supremacy.
Are you ready to flick your way to fame in **Flick Baseball Super Homerun**? Grab your bat, anticipate the pitch, and swing for the fences!

Ace your SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP exam effortlessly with our comprehensive preparation tool! Immerse yourself in an environment of realistic practice exams and quizzes designed to significantly enhance your likelihood of succeeding on the actual test at your first attempt. Boasting over 3,000 meticulously crafted questions by industry specialists, accompanied by thorough explanations for each, and an abundance of tests and quizzes readily available, our platform stands as the quintessential resource for your SHRM exam preparation.
We are excited to unveil our revolutionary AI feature, powered by ChatGPT, tailored to elevate your exam prep experience for the SHRM-CP or SHRM-SCP. This state-of-the-art tool offers immediate, customized support on the toughest exam subjects, ensuring you're well-equipped to tackle any challenge. Our AI, updated with the latest exam materials, flawlessly integrates with our question database, providing detailed insights into both correct and incorrect responses, and extending further advice to enhance your comprehension. Whether you're navigating through intricate HR topics or polishing your expertise, our AI guide is dedicated to assisting you every step of the way, guaranteeing your readiness to excel in your SHRM certification exam.
Our application is thoughtfully segmented into two distinct streams: SHRM-CP (Certified Professional) and SHRM-SCP (Senior Certified Professional), guaranteeing content specificity tailored to your certification goals.
## Pass On Your First Attempt ##
Praised for its detailed content analysis, innovative learning strategies, and meticulous accuracy, our SHRM exam prep app delves deeply into every aspect of the current exam syllabus, continuously updating our resources to maintain relevance. We provide extensive explanations for all answers, fostering a deep understanding of vital exam principles.
Moreover, our mobile app offers a customized study schedule that aligns with your proficiency level, study habits, and preferred exam date. Flexible in its design, you can modify your study plan anytime. Our unique readiness indicator will signal when you are primed to tackle the actual exam, aiming for a top score on your initial attempt.

* Unlimited Access to AI-Powered Study Tools

* Comprehensive Explanations

* Developed by Subject Matter Experts

* Convenient Reminders and Widgets

bluejetty:00036106:ios.description:
BestMe: Your Personalized Path to Success
BestMe is an innovative AI-driven app that helps you achieve your goals faster and more efficiently. Whether you want to become more confident, overcome procrastination, build wealth, or improve your health, BestMe creates a custom step-by-step plan tailored specifically to your needs.
With BestMe, every plan is personalized. The process begins when you input your goal — whether it’s financial freedom, self-improvement, or boosting your confidence. From there, BestMe’s AI generates a set of 24 personalized questions designed to analyze your current situation, challenges, and motivations. These questions are unique to each user, ensuring that your plan fits your lifestyle and objectives perfectly.
How It Works:
-Set your goal by entering any objective you want to achieve. BestMe’s AI will handle everything from career advancement to personal development.
-Next, answer 24 AI-generated questions, uniquely tailored to you, which help the app understand your strengths, challenges, and circumstances.
-After completing the questions, BestMe will generate a personalized, detailed action plan. This plan will break down your goal into manageable steps that are specific to your situation.
-To help you stay on track, your plan comes with a 24/7 AI assistant that is available to provide guidance, motivation, and answers to any questions you may have.
Subscription Options:
BestMe offers two mandatory subscription plans. The standard subscription allows you to create one personalized plan per month, perfect if you’re focusing on a single goal at a time. For those with multiple goals or a desire to make faster progress, you can upgrade to the pro subscription, which lets you create up to five personalized plans each month. This upgrade gives you the flexibility to work on several goals simultaneously and maximize your success. 
Key Features:
-BestMe delivers customized goal plans based on your specific circumstances, making sure that your path to success is tailored just for you.
-The AI-powered engine analyzes your responses and provides a step-by-step guide designed to make achieving your goals more efficient and manageable.
-Your AI assistant is available around the clock to help keep you motivated, answer questions, and ensure you remain on track.
-With BestMe, users are up to 15 times more likely to reach their goals than with traditional methods, making your journey quicker and more effective.
-BestMe supports a wide variety of goals, whether it’s career advancement, fitness improvement, financial growth, or personal development.
Who Is BestMe For?
BestMe is designed for anyone seeking to make progress in their personal or professional life but unsure where to start. Whether you’re struggling with procrastination, lack of motivation, or simply need guidance, BestMe provides the clear structure and support necessary to reach your goals. It’s particularly useful for individuals with busy schedules or those who need help staying focused, offering small, manageable steps to help you succeed.
Unlock Your Full Potential with BestMe
In today’s fast-paced world, staying focused on your goals can be challenging. BestMe provides the structure, motivation, and personalized planning you need to make consistent progress. By using cutting-edge AI, BestMe transforms your dreams into achievable milestones, helping you reach your goals faster and more efficiently. Download BestMe today and start unlocking your true potential.

Privacy policy: https://sites.google.com/vibemedia.app/privacy-policy/home

bluejetty:00030832:ios.description:
Discover Delight - Dating Redefined, One Match at a Time
Welcome to Delight, the revolutionary dating app that puts a fresh twist on finding love. We believe in quality over quantity, and we're passionate about connecting singles serious about finding a meaningful relationship.
Unveil the power of undivided attention with Delight's one-match-at-a-time feature. By focusing on a single connection, you can dive deeper, building a stronger bond and fostering genuine understanding.
Your Heart Speaks, Our Matchmaker Listens
Tell us what you're seeking in a partner. Our AI-powered MatchMaker becomes your personal cupid, understanding your desires, and aligning you with ideal recommendations.
The Delightful Difference
Experience the unique delight of MatchMaker Notes, personalized insights that explain why a recommended single could be your perfect fit. These notes are available for the cream of the crop recommendations, enhancing your understanding of potential compatibility.
Beyond the Usual
Delight offers advanced, effective filters to fine-tune your search. Height, ethnicity, education, religion - you name it, we have it covered.
Privacy, Safety, and Engagement
Engage in private, end-to-end encrypted conversations, assuring your data's security. Our robust verification system, using photo and ID checks, maintains a secure, trustworthy community.
Unleash the power of live video, audio calls, and audio messages. Connect more personally with your match, adding depth to your interaction.
Step into the world of Delight, and revolutionize your dating experience. One meaningful match at a time, let's find love that lasts.

bluejetty:00020705:ios.name: Turmoil
bluejetty:00020705:ios.summary: Turmoil is a casual business simulation game inspired by the oil rush in 19th-century North America. It is developed by Dutch game studio Gamious and published by LTGames. In Turmoil, you are up against time and rivals on your path to becom
bluejetty:00020705:ios.description:
Turmoil is a casual business simulation game inspired by the oil rush in 19th-century North America. It is developed by Dutch game studio Gamious and published by LTGames. In Turmoil, you are up against time and rivals on your path to becoming a succesful oil entrepreneur. Start raking in the oil money and watch the town grow along with you!
[Game Features]
*Real-Time Strategy, Oil Field Management
Acquire land at the town auction, and uncover oil with dowsers, moles, or scans. Create an efficient pipe network to get the oil above ground, and buy wagons and silos to transport and store it. Wait for the right price to sell, or use natural gas to raise the oil price yourself!
*Upgrade Technology, Expand Your Connections
There are dozens of upgrades and new tools that will improve your oil drilling operation. You will need them to drill through rocks, deal with natural gas pockets, and prevent oil spillage! Don't forget to visit the saloon, the people there may have some very juicy business proposals for you!
*Buy Stocks, Become a Mayor
Start from the bottom and rise to the top! Turmoil is not all about money, you also need town shares. Use your hard-earned cash to outbid your rivals at the stock auction and become the new mayor to win the game!
*Randomly Seeded World, Challenge Your Limits
Different settings and randomly generated levels provide an almost unlimited variety of oil-drilling challenges. Challenge other players to find out who's the real deal!
*The Heat Is On, Get Ready for the New DLC!
An entirely new campaign offers you the same oil-drilling fun, but with challenging twists and interesting bonuses. The addition of magma in the underground creates danger but also offers opportunies. You can also find underground artefacts and sell them in the village, but collecting them all might be more profitable! Play card games in the saloon to earn even more money!

bluejetty:00024102:ios.description:
It’s Christmas Eve in our hidden object games, and you’re a pretty doll that a little girl chose as her present. You can’t wait to get to your owner Frances, but one of Santa’s elves thinks you belong to the District of the Broken Toys! Unite with other toys in adventure games and escape from the factory! Start a long adventure of hide & seek games on your way to Frances. Be careful, as lots of obstacles and difficulties are lurking in the real world. However, friendship and your strong desire to make a girl happy will overcome everything. Will you manage to jump inside Frances’s present box before the clock strikes twelve? Play these gripping search & find games and find out! This is a free to play version of the Christmas Spirit: Journey Before Christmas, and its main feature is that you can play the entire hidden objects quest for free!
· ENJOY THE FANCY CHRISTMAS ATMOSPHERE!
Our fun game is going to envelop you in a cozy and comforting atmosphere of an approaching holiday. Get yourself a cup of hot cocoa and dive into this Christmas adventure with Domini Games!
· HELP YOUR TOY MASTER TO REMOVE HIS TIRING ENCHANTMENT IN THE BONUS CHAPTER! 
After you play through the main story of our hidden object games, you can embark on a new adventure in a bonus game! Can you manage to remove the enchantment and find hidden pictures? You’ll need all your wits and courage!
· GATHER INTERESTING TREATS AND OTHER COLLECTIONS! 
Replay your favorite point and click adventure and mini-games, solve fun puzzles and gather collectibles, cleverly hidden throughout the game!
· COOL ACHIEVEMENTS, WALLPAPERS, CONCEPT ARTS, AND MORE!
These finding games have plenty of extras for you to enjoy! Earn cool achievements, and download exclusive wallpapers, concept arts, music, and more!
Download one of the most amazing free hidden object games – Christmas Spirit: Journey Before Christmas! Play the game for absolutely free, but if you feel stuck or don’t want to solve a mini-game, you may buy hints to help you proceed quicker!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/

bluejetty:00016355:ios.summary:
・Customize your sound with EQ, Reverb & Crossfader
・Smart Shuffle picks 100 songs for you in 1 tap

[What is ETMusic?]

bluejetty:00016355:ios.description:
・Customize your sound with EQ, Reverb & Crossfader
・Smart Shuffle picks 100 songs for you in 1 tap
・Quick access to your most played & recently played tracks
[What is ETMusic?]
・Create personalized playlists by adding your favorite songs.
・Use the “Quick Preview” feature to play a short clip of a song while adding it to a playlist—perfect for when you think, “Wait, how does this one go again?”
・Enjoy music stored on your device with a powerful 11-band (up to 31-band) graphic equalizer, Reverb, and Crossfader controls.
・Sleep Timer feature lets you drift off to your favorite tunes—ideal for bedtime listening.
・Reverb effects transform your listening experience into a live concert atmosphere.
・Smart Shuffle selects 100 songs at random, refreshing your music experience.
・Apple Music users can switch to Apple Music mode to play songs added to your device—all without switching to the default Music app.
[Perfect for Those Who:]
・Feel frustrated when songs by your favorite artists suddenly disappear from subscription services.
・Prefer owning music over streaming.
・Are looking for a free music player app.
・Want to customize their listening experience using Equalizer and Reverb.
・Want to change the mood and tone of their songs using EQ.
・Listen to music as background BGM while working or studying.
・Want to enjoy uninterrupted music with a crossfader.
・Love the feeling of being at a live concert through Reverb effects.
・Want to fall asleep to music using a Sleep Timer.
・Want to listen to Apple Music tracks without switching apps.
[Features]
・“Quick Preview” allows short playback of songs while building a playlist. (Just tap the artwork while selecting tracks!)
・Widgets for easy and fast access to the app.
・Simple and intuitive graphic equalizer to shape your sound exactly how you like it.
・Easy-to-use crossfader eliminates silence between songs—perfect for commute or work.
・Background playback supported.
・Sleep Timer included for bedtime listening.
・Smart Shuffle automatically selects songs based on different themes!
・Smart Shuffle gives you a refreshing set of 100 songs when you’re tired of your usual playlist.
・Add Reverb to make your own live version of any track.
[About Premium Plan (Auto-Renewing Subscription)]
• A free trial is offered to those who register for the Premium Plan (monthly) for the first time. No charges will occur until the end of the free trial, and you can cancel anytime.
• If you continue the plan after the free trial, billing will start automatically.
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account after purchase.
• You can manage your subscription and cancel it from your App Store account settings.
• The Premium Plan will renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the renewal date.
• Renewal procedures will be conducted within 24 hours before the end of the subscription period.
• Simply deleting the app does not cancel the subscription.

Hit the road and become a drift legend in Highway Drifter: Hajwala Online!
Turn on your engine, hit the asphalt, and become a legendary drift king in Highway Drifter: Hajwala Online! Whether you are tearing through open desert highways, mastering high-speed street corners, or battling rivals in real-time online multiplayer, this is where true drift culture comes alive.
Experience next-generation driving physics, deep car tuning, and intense PvP drift battles designed for true car enthusiasts. The road is yours are you ready to rule it?
Why Players Love Highway Drifter:
Deep Car Customization & Tuning: Build your ultimate dream ride! Modify engines, tweak suspension and vehicle weight, swap custom rims, apply unique body kits, and unlock high-performance beasts built for extreme burnout battles.
Real Time Online Multiplayer PvP: Jump into live multiplayer servers! Challenge friends and rival drivers worldwide, join drift clubs, and show everyone who the true master of Hajwala is.
Diverse Open-World Maps: Slide across massive open-world desert dunes Tafheet weave through dense city traffic, and dominate high-speed highway freeways in dynamic day and night environments.
Next Gen Realistic Physics: Feel every gear shift, tire screech, and turbo boost. Our advanced driving simulator engine delivers ultra-smooth controls and realistic crash mechanics that make every drift feel earned.
Competitive Scoring & Leaderboards: Push your modified car to the limit! Chain massive drift combos, shatter global high scores, and climb the ranks from street racer to undisputed Drift King.
Play Your Way
Whether you want a casual solo offline drive through the desert or intense online drifting battles, Highway Drifter gives you total freedom on the road.
Download now and start your unforgettable Hajwala adventure today!

Exclusive recipes, full premium videos, ad-free experience.

bluejetty:00023141:ios.name: Supermarket Village—Farm Town
bluejetty:00023141:ios.summary:
Ready to open a supermarket in a new town? Become a manager in a nice, pleasant village and sell homemade products!
Take the challenge and run your own farm to offer fresh food to the locals. Build your dream town while expanding your busi
bluejetty:00023141:ios.description:
Ready to open a supermarket in a new town? Become a manager in a nice, pleasant village and sell homemade products!
Take the challenge and run your own farm to offer fresh food to the locals. Build your dream town while expanding your business, and be the most famous neighbor thanks to your hard work!
OPEN NEW MARKET SECTIONS: 
Harvest crops and feed animals, and produce enough feedstock to process different products for your clients. Improve your supermarket as you build new factories, expand your fields and farms, and handle online orders. Your village will need a bakery, dairy section, meat section, or even a produce department! Hire cashiers and stockers to replenish the racks with all kinds of tasty products!
BUILD YOUR VILLAGE: 
Expand your town with new buildings and farming areas! Open factories, create new crop fields, open a cowshed, a chicken coop, or a refinery. Don’t forget to supply your supermarket! Unlock a dairy factory, bread factory, meat plant, or beverage factory. Create your local brand, and put your village on the map!
ELABORATE YOUR PRODUCTS:
Plant and harvest different types of seeds such as wheat, corn, tomatoes, apples, or carrots. Take care of animals such as cows, chickens, hens, or pigs in your farmyards. Collect milk, meat, or eggs and manufacture a lot of products according to the demand. Adapt your strategy to your supermarket needs!

bluejetty:00014438:ios.name: Mile Logger - Mileage tracker
bluejetty:00014438:ios.description:
MileLogger — Drive. Track. Deduct.
 The only mileage tracker that's 100% free, forever. No subscription. No account. No data sent anywhere. Just open the app and drive.
 Every mile you drive for work is worth $0.725 in tax deductions in 2026 — MileLogger makes sure you never miss one.
 ---
 FREE. FOREVER. NO CATCHES.
 No free tier that locks you out. No trial that expires. No "upgrade to unlock" — every feature is available to every user, always. We believe your mileage data belongs to you, not a subscription service.
 ---
 HOW IT WORKS
 - Drive — MileLogger detects your trip automatically in the background
 - Classify — swipe left for Personal, right for Business (or set Work Hours to auto-classify)
 - Report — view your mileage value by month or year, and export when tax season arrives
 That's it.
 ---
 KEY FEATURES
 Automatic Trip Detection
 Starts and stops recording the moment you drive — no tapping, no forgetting. Runs silently in the background.
 Smart Auto-Classification
 Set your work schedule once. MileLogger automatically marks drives during work hours as Business and drives outside as Personal — hands-free.
 2026 IRS Rate Built In
 Every business mile is calculated at the current IRS standard rate of $0.725/mile. Always up to date.
 Detailed Reports
 Monthly and yearly summaries show your total miles, trip count, and tax deduction value at a glance. Export a full CSV report to share with your accountant in one tap.
 No Account Required
 Open the app and go. No email. No password. No sign-up screen. Nothing.
 Your Data Stays on Your Device
 All trips and settings are stored locally on your iPhone. Nothing is sent to any server. Backup to your personal iCloud — only you can access it.
 Named Locations & Custom Purposes
 Label your home, office, and frequent stops. Tag trips with custom purposes for cleaner records and audit-ready logs.
 Vehicle Management
 Track mileage across multiple vehicles separately.
 ---
 WHO IT'S FOR
 - Freelancers and independent contractors
 - Delivery and rideshare drivers (Uber, Lyft, DoorDash)
 - Real estate agents and sales professionals
 - Small business owners and self-employed professionals
 - Anyone who drives for work and wants the deduction
 ---
 PRIVACY FIRST
 We don't have your data because we never asked for it. No account means no breach. No server means no leak. Your trip history lives on your phone and your iCloud — period.
 ---
 ICLOUD BACKUP
 Back up your entire trip history to iCloud with one tap. Restore it just as easily. Your data follows you when you get a new phone — no account migration, no CSV import, no hassle.
 ---
 Stop paying monthly for something that should be free.
 Download MileLogger and keep every dollar you've earned on the road
Terms of User and Privacy Policy
https://dajax.com/terms.html

Sausage Flip
Can you make it flip and jump? 
The time has come...to free the sausage!
The barbecue is about to start, the fire is lit and the coals are burning.

Make easy payments and transfers without any queue.
— Free download and quick registration.

— Visa card order. Leave an application for plastic and digital Visa cards in the All cards section.

— Always near. If you have any questions, write in the app chat or in Telegram bot @alifmobiuzbot. We will answer at any time.

Start with BK Shivani's daily affirmations and Morning Zen sessions. Set a positive intention before the world gets busy. 
YOUR MIDDAY RITUAL 
Reset with a 5-minute meditation or breathing exercise. Quick Meditations and Mini Breaks help you stay grounded through a demanding day. 
YOUR NIGHT RITUAL 
Wind down with 100+ Sleep Stories, sleep sounds, and guided sleep meditations designed to help you fall asleep naturally and wake up restored.

Daily Affirmations: BK Shivani's guidance to start every morning with purpose

Music and Sound Therapy: Ambient music, Indian raagas, solfeggio frequencies, and sacred chants for focus, healing, and deep relaxation

ThinkRight Kids: Meditations, stories, and movement for children 
Offline Downloads: Practice anywhere, with or without internet

bluejetty:00030356:ios.name: Maritime Academy: ICS Flags
bluejetty:00030356:ios.summary:
Features:
- designed for mariners, travellers, yachtsmen, pleasure cruisers and anyone who enjoys spending time around the waterfront.
- 104 levels and 35 challenges teaching and training maritime flag signalling and the International Code
bluejetty:00030356:ios.description:
Features:
- designed for mariners, travellers, yachtsmen, pleasure cruisers and anyone who enjoys spending time around the waterfront.
- 104 levels and 35 challenges teaching and training maritime flag signalling and the International Code of Signals (ICS).
- 6 chapters including Letters, Numbers, Words, Substitutes, Single Flag Meanings and Abbreviations.
- effective and fun teaching and training strategy: learn and train first with ease and then challenge yourself with pressure.
- calculated amount of repetition for smooth and efficient memorization and progress.
- explore all the letters, numbers, substitutes and abbreviations at your own pace on the Explore screen.
- info screen offering detailed explanation of how to make the most of the app.
- absolutely no ads.
- works completely offline.
--------
About Maritime Academy
The app teaches maritime flag signalling (generally flaghoist signalling), which is the principal means other than radio by which ships communicate to each other or to shore.
Virtually all signalling by non-naval vessels is now organized under the International Code of Signals (whether by flaghoist, semaphore, signal lamp, or other means), which specifies a standard set of flags and codes and is the most recent evolution of a wide variety of maritime flag signalling systems. Naval vessels generally use an extended set of flags and their own codes.
--------
Teaching method
The two key teaching and training concepts are progressive introduction and focused repetition. The learning material is categorized into chapters and then broken down into manageable units (levels) to ensure efficient learning and training.
--------
Learning material
In general, the learning progresses from single-flag content to multi-flag content. That is to say, from letters & numbers to words & substitutes, and then to single flag meanings & abbreviations. The content is arranged for optimal efficiency and we strongly recommend you to go through the levels in this order.
- Letters (8 levels + 4 challenges)
- Numbers (3 levels + 1 challenge)
- Words (30 levels)
- Substitutes (1 level)
- Single Flag Meanings (8 levels + 4 challenges)
- Abbreviations (54 levels + 26 challenges)
--------
Levels and challenges
In short, a level focuses on introducing and training new letters/numbers/abbreviations, while a challenge tests what you’ve learnt. In the learning screen, the knowledge you should focus on is highlighted and in the training screen, you will practice by answering a few questions (like a quiz game). In a challenge, you must make less than 3 mistakes to pass it.
--------
Training types
There are three training types, that is to say, key, typing and button.
- In Letters & Numbers levels, you need to press the keys of the keyboard on the screen to answer the questions.
- In Words & Substitutes levels, you need to type whole words to answer the questions.
- In Single Flag Meanings & Abbreviations levels, you need to choose the correct meaning by clicking on a button.
--------
The Explore screen
The Explore screen allows users to check out the International Flags and Pennants of the 26 letters of the English Alphabet, numbers (0-9), substitutes (3), as well as the International Code of Signals including 25 single flag meanings and 201 most frequently used abbreviations. Simply click on the blocks to start exploring.
--------
Download Maritime Academy now and start learning the signal flags!

Terms of Use: https://www.dong.digital/maritimeacademy/tos/

Spend less time waiting and know what is coming next.

BUILT FOR YOUR DAILY COMMUTE

• Return to your favorites without searching again
• Choose light, dark or system appearance
• Continue browsing routes and saved items when location is unavailable
NYC PRO

• Full 7-day schedules
• Live vehicle positions on route maps when data is available
• An ad-free experience across both app experiences

bluejetty:00021510:ios.description:
A FUN PUZZLE GAME THAT BUILDS LOGIC FROM AGE 4
Help Pango draw a path without ever crossing the same road twice.
70 evolving challenges that boost your child’s logic, observation skills, and patience…
A calm, pressure-free game designed to support reflection, independence, and self-confidence — at their own pace.
15 YEARS OF EXPERTISE SERVING YOUNG CHILDREN
Our Pango collection includes over 20 apps known for their educational value, accessibility, and child-friendly design.
With more than 15 million children around the world already playing, Pango One Road continues our commitment to creating smart, simple, and kind games that make learning fun.
A GAME FOR THINKING AT YOUR OWN PACE
• Designed for children ages 4 and up
• Evolving levels with no stress or scores
• Builds logic, observation, and planning skills
• Encourages independence and confidence
• A colorful, intuitive world with no ads
Each level is a small logic challenge that nurtures focus and the joy of success — without pressure.
A SMOOTH EXPERIENCE ON SMARTPHONES AND TABLETS
• Instantly accessible, designed for small hands
• Clean design, simple and fluid gestures
• Perfect for short sessions, travel, or quiet time
A SIMPLE AND TRANSPARENT SUBSCRIPTION
Pango One Road uses a monthly or yearly subscription.
You get full access to the game, with no hidden purchases.
• Auto-renewal (can be turned off anytime in your account settings)
• No cancellation fees
• Your previous purchases remain available
A 100% SAFE GAME
• No ads
• No external links
• A protected Parents section
• Complies with child privacy regulations
A TEAM THAT CARES AND LISTENS
For 15 years, we’ve been creating games at a child’s level.
Games that respect their pace, spark curiosity, and grow their logic — without stress, pressure, or ads. Because a great game is one that helps children grow!
Need help? Contact us at pango@studio-pango.com or visit our FAQ. More info: www.studio-pango.com
DOWNLOAD PANGO ONE ROAD and start your child on 70 fun and brain-boosting challenges!

bluejetty:00021938:ios.name: Learn Trumpet - tonestro
bluejetty:00021938:ios.summary: Learn to play the trumpet, the cornet and the flugelhorn in Bb and C and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the trumpet and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your t
bluejetty:00021938:ios.description:
Learn to play the trumpet, the cornet and the flugelhorn in Bb and C and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the trumpet and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your trumpet easily.
You can learn and play
- Trumpet
- Cornet
- Flugelhorn
in Bb and C.
tonestro for Trumpet offers a large collection of songs, exercises and guided lessons for every skill level. Learn how to read music notes and improve your trumpet skills by playing many songs and exercises.
With the tuner you tune your trumpet fast and easily for perfect pitch. A metronome and specially composed background music with play alongs for many songs guide you the way to perfect rhythm.
Weekly challenges with hand-picked songs give you the extra motivation to improve your skills when you compare yourself with trumpet players from around the world.
OVERVIEW
- Get instant feedback on rhythm & pitch
- Learn to play the trumpet or learn something new
- Enjoy a large collection of songs
- Discover trumpet lessons & exercises
- Start with your first lessons on music notes or choose from many songs
- Learn the correct fingerings with fingering charts
- Tune your trumpet with our integrated tuner
- Enjoy songs with play alongs
- Stay motivated with weekly challenges
LEARN
Learn how to play the trumpet or improve your skills with lessons, fingering charts and exercises. Step-by-step lessons will guide you through your first notes on the trumpet. Detailed explanations and fingering charts tell you how to play a certain note. A tuner helps you find the correct pitch. Test your knowledge in exams and see how fast you progress. Use your newly learned skills and play your first songs on your trumpet.
For experienced trumpet players there’s always something new to learn with advanced lessons, songs and exercises.
PRACTICE
Use tonestro’s live-feedback feature on rhythm and pitch to improve your skills. See where you struggle with intonation and work on your pitch to become a better trumpet player. Switch to practice mode and choose a slower tempo to work on getting that rhythm right. Let the metronome guide you through the songs and use the tuner to not only tune your trumpet but also to see which notes are the ones you have to be very careful with pitch.
PLAY
Discover songs from all music genres and play trumpet songs for every skill level. Whether you’re a fan of classical music or you prefer jazz songs instead: With tonestro’s large sheet music library you’ll find just the songs you need for playing your trumpet.
And you don’t have to play alone: With play alongs you’re playing with a whole band in the background. Always on your side is the tonestro tuner, which is an easy-to-use tuner that will make sure that you’re in tune. And there’s always the metronome that will guide you through the songs.
COMPETE
Do you want to prove your skills? Enter our weekly challenges! Compete with trumpet players from around the world and fight for the podium. Practice the songs to score as many points as possible and become the best trumpet player in the tonestro world. Don’t forget to use the tuner first, so that you can start the challenge with perfect preparation.

Learn to play the trumpet, the cornet and the flugelhorn in Bb and C and improve on rhythm and pitch. tonestro listens to you while you play the trumpet and gives you immediate live-feedback on rhythm and pitch. A tuner lets you tune your trumpet easily.

You can learn and play
- Trumpet
- Cornet
- Flugelhorn
in Bb and C.

tonestro for Trumpet offers a large collection of songs, exercises and guided lessons for every skill level. Learn how to read music notes and improve your trumpet skills by playing many songs and exercises.

With the tuner you tune your trumpet fast and easily for perfect pitch. A metronome and specially composed background music with play alongs for many songs guide you the way to perfect rhythm.

Weekly challenges with hand-picked songs give you the extra motivation to improve your skills when you compare yourself with trumpet players from around the world.

OVERVIEW

- Get instant feedback on rhythm & pitch
- Learn to play the trumpet or learn something new
- Enjoy a large collection of songs
- Discover trumpet lessons & exercises
- Start with your first lessons on music notes or choose from many songs
- Learn the correct fingerings with fingering charts
- Tune your trumpet with our integrated tuner
- Enjoy songs with play alongs

LEARN

Learn how to play the trumpet or improve your skills with lessons, fingering charts and exercises. Step-by-step lessons will guide you through your first notes on the trumpet. Detailed explanations and fingering charts tell you how to play a certain note. A tuner helps you find the correct pitch. Test your knowledge in exams and see how fast you progress. Use your newly learned skills and play your first songs on your trumpet.

For experienced trumpet players there’s always something new to learn with advanced lessons, songs and exercises.

PRACTICE

Use tonestro’s live-feedback feature on rhythm and pitch to improve your skills. See where you struggle with intonation and work on your pitch to become a better trumpet player. Switch to practice mode and choose a slower tempo to work on getting that rhythm right. Let the metronome guide you through the songs and use the tuner to not only tune your trumpet but also to see which notes are the ones you have to be very careful with pitch.

PLAY

COMPETE

Do you want to prove your skills? Enter our weekly challenges! Compete with trumpet players from around the world and fight for the podium. Practice the songs to score as many points as possible and become the best trumpet player in the tonestro world. bluejetty:00024899:ios.description:
Hello History, you can travel back in time and have one-on-one chat conversations with some of the most influential historical figures of all time
Who Hello History is for?
- History Teachers eager to enrich their classrooms
- School Principals seeking innovative learning tools
- History Buffs craving deeper connections with the past
- Parents wanting to increase their kids' interest in history 
- Anyone who's always wanted to "meet" historical figures
Key Features:
- Authentic Conversations with AI Historical Figures
- Curated Topics for Tailored Learning
- Easy-to-Use Interface
- Regular Updates with New Figures
- Multi-disciplinary Focus: Art, Science, Philosophy, and more
Why Hello History?
Unearth the wisdom of ages with Hello History! Engage in riveting 
one-on-one chats with AI versions of history's most iconic figures. 
State-of-the-art GPT-4 AI technology makes each interaction uniquely 
authentic.
Broaden Your Horizons
From art and music to justice and pop music history, pick the brain of your favorite genius in a myriad of disciplines. It's not just a history lesson; it's a fresh perspective on life itself!
Elevate Your Teaching
For educators, it’s like having a co-teacher from the annals of history! Enhance your students' engagement and understanding by integrating these AI-generated conversations into your curriculum.
 Highly Advanced, Yet User-Friendly
Even if you're not tech-savvy, the intuitive UI makes it easy to navigate conversations. And for AI fans, witness the marvel of GPT-4 technology in action.
Immerse yourself in the minds of the greats and gain new insights and perspectives on life, history, and the world around us with the help of AI chat.
Whether you're interested in learning more about art, music, justice, literature, philosophy, science, technology, or even military strategy, Hello History has a wide range of historical figures to choose from. You can have a chat with AI versions of many famous historical figures.
It's like having a private tutor with the greatest people of the past.
How it works: The app uses state-of-the-art (GPT-4) AI technology to bring these figures to life and make the conversations feel authentic. Each conversation is completely unique. Don't trust everything the AI generates. The facts should be validated.
Enhance your knowledge of history and gain a new perspective on life by downloading Hello History today. Open up a conversation with anyone from the past, and who knows where it may take you!
P.S. New figures are added all the time, so you’ll never run out of interesting people to talk to.
The SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
Hello History offers three auto-renewing subscription options:
1. Weekly
2. Month
3. Yearly
Subscription unlocks extra messages to historical figures.
You can send up to 10'000 messages per month if you are subscribed. Pricing per country may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and you will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term
- Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Read more about the privacy policy:
https://sites.google.com/view/hello-history-terms/privacy-policy
Read more about the terms of usage:
https://sites.google.com/view/hello-history-terms/home

bluejetty:00024567:ios.summary: Introducing the Smart Gallery Photo Viewer and Gallery Video Viewer – your gateway to an unlimited world of captivating memories. Imagine effortlessly showcasing your cherished photos and videos to friends and beyond, all with a touch of el
bluejetty:00024567:ios.description:
Introducing the Smart Gallery Photo Viewer and Gallery Video Viewer – your gateway to an unlimited world of captivating memories. Imagine effortlessly showcasing your cherished photos and videos to friends and beyond, all with a touch of elegance and security. 
Embrace the magic of the Gallery for Photos & Video app, your ultimate haven for preserving and admiring visuals. Unlike any other, this app brings your images and videos together under one virtual roof. With a touch of your fingers, organize, enhance, and share your digital treasures with flair.
Unveil the secret to guarding your memories with the Gallery Lock feature. Encrypt your images and videos, allowing you to keep your personal collection hidden from prying eyes. It's your very own digital vault.
Experience the HD Gallery – a place where your snapshots come to life, beautifully framed in albums. Be the curator of your own world, selecting the best shots and storing them in enigmatic envelopes, ready to be revealed at your command.
Step into the realm of the Gallery Explorer, where your photographs are no longer scattered across devices but are instead woven into artistic albums that tell your unique story. Dive into the slick gallery view, seamlessly navigating through your memories with grace.
But that's not all. Picture this: a Gallery 3D that dances to the rhythm of your preferences. Organize your cherished photos, arrange them based on your whims, and instantly access them with just a tap.
Features abound in this Gallery Symphony:
- Craft mesmerizing photo albums that adapt to your device's orientation.
- Capture candid moments with a selfie camera designed for photo albums.
- Effortlessly exclude and restore folders at your command.
- Immerse yourself in an endless slideshow of HD Gallery for photos, with animations that mesmerize.
- Seamlessly move, copy, and paste files, all with a swift multi-select.
- Elevate your photos with Beauty Camera Effects, turning ordinary moments into masterpieces.
- Let your personality shine by customizing the theme color – your Gallery, your rules.
- No need to settle – switch colors and themes as you please.
- Your photos and videos in their full glory, supported across all popular formats.
- Dive deep into your visuals with intuitive zoom gestures.
- And don't forget the Video Player with Gallery apps:
Embrace a unified video experience with support for all formats.
Bask in the glory of the finest video player for your galleries.
Seamlessly manage and enjoy all your videos, without a hitch.
Immerse yourself in the world of beautifully designed HD video playback.
Photos, your way:
Explore a limitless video grid, each frame more mesmerizing than the last.
Zoom, crop, and enhance with picture filters to reveal unseen details.
Personalize your photos by renaming and editing to perfection.
Effortlessly share your visual stories on social media, a tap away.
Order and sort your memories as you desire, to relive them your way.
Present your photos in an appearance that exudes professionalism.
Safety first with the Gallery Lock:
----------
Gallery terms of service
1 week Gallery+ from 4.99$ per week (prices may vary slightly depending on the region).
1 month Gallery + from 19.99$ per month (prices may vary slightly depending on the region)
You can find all in-app purchases on this app store page below under “In-app purchases”.
Subscriptions are automatically renewed unless they have been switched off at least 24 hours before the subscription period expires. Your account will be charged within 24 hours of payment. You can manage your subscriptions in the iOS settings and switch the automatic renewal on or off. A subscription that is already running cannot be canceled within the term that has already started.
Privacy Policy: https://zipoapps.com/galleryvaultios/privacy 
Terms: https://zipoapps.com/galleryvaultios/terms/

bluejetty:00035214:ios.description:
Discover a new way to build and maintain healthy habits with Otto, your motivational virtual pet companion who makes healthy habits fun and achievable. Whether you’re managing ADHD or looking for a powerful habit tracker and planner, Otto helps you stay organized and motivated. Raise your adorable Otto by taking care of yourself and completing your daily to-do list!
Are healthy habits hard to stick to? Looking for a fun and supportive health app to establish a self-care routine? Otto is the ultimate virtual pet and habit tracker that combines the best features of a planner, to-do list, and journal. Otto makes building and sustaining healthy habits enjoyable and straightforward while helping you achieve your goals.
WHY OTTO IS THE BEST DAILY HABIT TRACKER?
Start your day with personalized goals using Otto’s habit tracker and planner. Energize your virtual pet Otto for daily adventures! Stay on track with your daily to-do list and watch your healthy habits flourish.
End your day with Otto by reviewing your progress and celebrating achievements. Every completed task on your to-do list helps your Otto grow, unlock rewards, and discover exciting new items along the way.
UNIQUE FEATURES OF OTTO
- Planner & To-Do List: Organize your day effectively with Otto’s comprehensive planner and customizable to-do list.
- Habit Tracker: Build and monitor daily habits using Otto’s intuitive habit tracker, designed for all users, including those managing ADHD.
- Supporting ADHD: Otto offers features like reminders, achievable goal-setting, and a fun virtual pet to keep you motivated and focused.
- Explorations & Gamification: Energize your Otto to explore, discover items, and develop new attributes.
- Customizable Virtual Pet: Personalize your Otto with new outfits and accessories as you complete goals on your to-do list.
- Growth & Rewards: Watch your Otto grow and evolve as you use the habit tracker and complete tasks with the planner.
With Otto, your planner, to do list, and habit tracker are all in one convenient app, making it easier than ever to create healthy habits and achieve your goals! Embrace the journey to wellness with Otto as your trusted companion, and transform your daily routine into an enjoyable adventure. Let’s grow together and celebrate each milestone along the way!
Start your free trial and experience the full benefits of Otto on your well-being. Subscription options: $9.99/month, $29.99/year, $49.99/year, $79.99/lifetime. These prices are for United States. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
The subscription will automatically renew unless turned off in your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the current period ends. You can go to your iTunes Account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your iTunes Account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. If you subscribe before your free trial ends, the rest of your free trial period will be forfeited as soon as your purchase is confirmed.

bluejetty:00027445:ios.name: This Week: Weekly Task Planner
bluejetty:00027445:ios.summary:
Plan your tasks by day. This Week is similar to a calendar but every day is a list instead of an agenda. Put tasks into any day of this week or next week, or just add it to the "Later" list!
HOW IT WORKS
With This Week, tasks don’t use tim
bluejetty:00027445:ios.description:
Plan your tasks by day. This Week is similar to a calendar but every day is a list instead of an agenda. Put tasks into any day of this week or next week, or just add it to the "Later" list!
HOW IT WORKS
With This Week, tasks don’t use time of day. You can plan your day by rearranging tasks into an ordered list so you can do them one by one. 
This new approach to planning your to-dos is designed to fit real life. Other apps want to appeal to enterprises so they add lots of scheduling, calendars, and other enterprise features. This Week is designed for our personal lives where we may know what tasks we'd like to do on a given day, but not exactly when.
OTHER FEATURES
● Time-reminders
● Geo-reminders
● Sub-tasks
● Photo attachments 
● Drag & drop to rearrange 
Need a reminder for something? This Week offers both time reminders and geo reminders! Get a notification at a particular time or when leaving or arriving at a particular location. 
Use sub-tasks to make grocery lists or shopping lists for a particular store, without making your main list explode in length!
Attach photos to your tasks. Need a paint that compliments your couch? Attach a picture of your couch to your “Buy Paint” task!
PRO MEMBERSHIP (Available as an In-App Purchase)
The free version of This Week was built to work extremely well for users. All the fundamentals from This Week v1.0 are free! We chose to start with "Themes" as the only Pro feature so that everyone could still enjoy the core features of the app we've worked so hard to create.
As we roll out new abilities, like syncing and Siri integration, some of those features will require a Pro Membership. As two indie-developers with normal jobs and bills, we also appreciate the support!
Cost Details on Pro Membership
 – Monthly: $2
 - Yearly: $10
How Does Pro Membership Work?
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
Privacy Policy: https://davegetman.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://davegetman.com/terms-of-use/

bluejetty:00026512:ios.description:
Become a superhero and save the city from crime in the brand new open world game! Fight your way through the mafia and gangsters using your incredible combat skills. Traverse the city using the web to swing from building to building and explore locations.
Experience an open-world adventure that will take you through the city's bustling streets and sprawling skylines. With the ability to climb walls and leap great distances, you'll feel like a true superhero as you take on any challenge that comes your way.
Join forces with the iconic superheroes as you battle against some of the most dangerous villains in the universe. With an array of customizable abilities and a wide variety of weapons at your disposal, you'll be able to take down anyone who stands in your way.
But be warned, the city is filled with dangers at every turn. From corrupt politicians to ruthless gangsters, you'll need to use all of your wits and skills to survive. With a gripping storyline that will keep you on the edge of your seat, a brand new Super Fighter 3 game is the ultimate open-world adventure for fans of the genre.
- Play as your favorite superheroes and fight the city's biggest villains
- Travel the city using the web to explore locations
- Battle against the mafia, gangsters, and other dangerous criminals
- Join forces with iconic superheroes
- Customizable abilities and a wide variety of weapons at your disposal
- Gripping missions that will keep you on the edge of your seat
With vivid graphics, intuitive controls, and non-stop action, it is the ultimate open-world adventure for fans of the genre. Whether you're a fan of the comics or just love action-packed games, this is one title you won't want to miss. Get ready to fight for justice and save the city from the brink of destruction!
