bluejetty:00017986:ios.name: GVC Mobile App
bluejetty:00017986:ios.summary: Use the Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union Mobile App to manage your finances virtually - whenever and wherever you are! This free App provides easy and secure access to your Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union accounts; manage y
bluejetty:00017986:ios.description:
Use the Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union Mobile App to manage your finances virtually - whenever and wherever you are! This free App provides easy and secure access to your Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union accounts; manage your accounts, pay bills, deposit cheques, transfer money and more!
FEATURES INCLUDE:
•Check account balances
•View transaction history
•Transfer money between your accounts
•Send and receive funds securely with Interac® e-Transfer
•Pay bills or schedule upcoming payments
•Deposit cheques from your smartphone or tablet using Deposit Anywhere™
•Branch/ATM locator utilizing your phone’s GPS
•Rate information
•Financial Calculators
•Optional Quickview allows fast access to account balances without logging in
BENEFITS
•Free download
•Easy navigation
•Same login credentials as our full online banking site
ACCESS
To take advantage of the full functionality of this app, you must already be registered and have logged in to Online Banking. Simply login with the same login information as you would the full Online Banking site. If you have not tried Online Banking, visit the nearest Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union branch to sign up for free! If you do not wish to be an Online Banking member, you can still use the Branch/ATM locator, Rates, Calculators and our Contact Us information.
There is no charge for the app however mobile data downloading and internet charges may apply. Check with your mobile phone provider for details.
SECURITY
Your security is important to us, which is why our mobile banking app uses the same level of secure protection as our full Online Banking website. Once you have logged out of the app your secure session ends.
For our privacy and security policy, please visit our website.
PERMISSIONS
By downloading the Greater Vancouver Community Credit Union Mobile app, you consent to the installation of the app and any future updates or upgrades. You may withdraw your consent at any time by deleting or uninstalling the app from your device.
When you install the app it will ask for permission to access the following functions of your device:
• Location services – allows the app to use your device's GPS to find the nearest branch or ATM
• Camera – allows the app to use device camera to take picture of cheque
• Contacts – allows you to create new INTERAC® e-Transfer recipients by selecting from your device contacts.

bluejetty:00035629:ios.description:
Transform your health journey with Fit AI! Designed to make tracking and achieving your wellness goals effortless, Fit AI uses cutting-edge AI to help you track calories simply by snapping a photo of your meals. Whether you're looking to cut weight, track nutrition, or monitor your daily intake, Fit AI provides accurate and easy-to-use insights right at your fingertips.
Key Features:
- Calorie Tracking with AI: Just snap a picture, and let Fit AI handle the rest! Instantly analyze your food’s calories and nutritional content for effortless tracking.
- Comprehensive Weight Management: Track your weight over time, set achievable goals, and let Fit AI support your journey.
- In-Depth Nutrition Insights: Get precise breakdowns of key nutrients, helping you make healthier choices and stick to your diet plan.
- Progress Tracking & Analytics: Monitor your progress with monthly insights to help you stay motivated.
Health app integration:
Fit AI shows you the step data from the Health app (HealthKit).
Fit AI does not create any data. It simply reads data from the Health app
Subscription Information: 
Unlock all features with a subscription, available through in-app purchases. A 3-day free trial is offered, after which users can choose between a monthly or yearly plan.
- 3-Day Free Trial: Access all features at no cost for 3 days.
- Subscription Required: After the free trial, continued access to premium features requires a subscription (auto-renews monthly or yearly). Prices vary by location.

bluejetty:00034022:ios.description:
Discover the power of Rock Identifier, your all-in-one Rock & Crystal Scanner for identifying stones, gems, minerals, and crystals. Whether you're a seasoned geologist or a curious beginner, Rock Identifier transforms your device into an intelligent rock scanner that unlocks the secrets of Earth's treasures.
Instant Rock & Crystal Identification
Simply take a photo or upload an image of any rock, crystal, or mineral, and our advanced AI will provide you with accurate results in seconds. Rock Id can recognize over 6,000 types of rocks and minerals!
Comprehensive Stone Information
Each Rock identification includes:
• Rock type and specific name
• Mineral composition
• Texture and hardness
• Color variations
• Formation process
• Geological age
• Common uses
• Locations where it can be found
AI Accuracy
Our Rock Identifier provides a confidence level for each identification, ensuring reliable results for your rock hunting adventures.
Gemstone Authentication Guide
Learn to distinguish real from fake gemstones with our practical identification methods, considering factors like color, cleavage, fracture, touch, shape, and transparency.
Rock & Crystal Encyclopedia
Explore our extensive database of stones, crystals, and minerals. Discover healing properties, zodiac connections, and fascinating facts about each specimen.
Personal Rock Collection Manager
Build and organize your digital rock collection within Rock Identifier. Add notes, create wishlists, and track your geological discoveries.
Join over 1 million rock enthusiasts who have already discovered the wonders of the mineral world with Rock Identifier! Whether you're a rock hound, crystal collector, or geology student, our Rock & Crystal Scanner is your ultimate companion for mineral exploration and learning.
Download Rock Identifier now and embark on your journey to become a rock expert! Uncover the stories hidden within every stone, crystal, and mineral you encounter.
Note: Rock Identifier offers optional premium features through in-app purchases. Subscription details are available within the app.

bluejetty:00026746:ios.summary:
~ WEATHER DOESN’T HAVE TO BE BORING ~
The simple weather app that’s winning awards (Apple Design Award, Best Weather Apps) and impressing tastemakers (MKBHD, Fast Company).
~ PLAYFUL YET FUNCTIONAL DESIGN ~
Turn your daily weather forecast
bluejetty:00026746:ios.description:
~ WEATHER DOESN’T HAVE TO BE BORING ~
The simple weather app that’s winning awards (Apple Design Award, Best Weather Apps) and impressing tastemakers (MKBHD, Fast Company).
~ PLAYFUL YET FUNCTIONAL DESIGN ~
Turn your daily weather forecast into a memorable experience with a next-generation user interface design inspired by 3D video games. Feel the rain, hear the thunder, and watch the wind blow across your screen in vivid detail.
~ TOP WEATHER SOURCES ~
Powered by local data from the best weather sources like Accuweather, Foreca, Apple Weather, and the National Weather Service for the most local, most accurate forecasts.
~ MORE DETAILED ~
Explore every aspect of the weather for rich details on temperature changes, air quality (AQI), pollen reports, cloud cover, visibility, wind direction, rainfall, humidity, UV index, and much more. 
~ MINUTE FORECASTS™ ~
Designed for precise forecasts down to the minute. Know exactly when the downpour will start or when the dark sky will clear.
~ WIDGETS ~
Bring real-time weather data to your home screen and lock screen with simple widgets. Get frequent updates on the day’s temperature, conditions, rain, air quality, UV index, and wind conditions as they happen.
~ SEVERE WEATHER ALERTS ~
Keep an eye on severe weather alerts and be prepared for the next heat wave, storm tracking, flood risk, hurricane, blizzard, and more.
~ MOON PHASES ~
Astronomical moon phases and illumination. It’s simple to see when the next full moon and new moon are expected.
~ AIR QUALITY & POLLEN ~
Prepare for the outdoors with air quality index (AQI) and pollen forecasts. See AQI scores and pollen levels over the coming hours or days.
~ CUSTOM APP ICONS & SKINS ~
Collect app icons and custom skins that change the design of the entire app to match your mood. New icons, skins, and artist collaborations dropping regularly to keep your routine fresh.
~ MINIGAME & SURPRISES ~
Say hello to Cloudburst to pass the time or see how many hidden surprises you can find.
~ FREE OR UPGRADE ~
!Weather™ is free to use for as long as you need. Upgrade for realtime widgets, faster forecasts, more in-depth weather data like AQI and pollen, free skins, app icons, and wallpapers.
~ SUPER !BORING ~
Become a member and unlock access to all 5 Not Boring apps, skins, app icons, wallpapers, and more. We’re 100% member-supported. No ads, no data tracking.
Plans: https://notboring.software/plans
Support: https://notboring.software/support

Get a local phone number for your business and a unified inbox to simplify communication with customers. Try free for 7 days!

bluejetty:00022769:ios.description:
Stop retyping the same replies.
Copied keeps reusable text and clipboard history inside a custom keyboard, so your replies are ready where you type.
SAVE REUSABLE KEYS
Create one-tap Keys for customer replies, prices, addresses, links, email templates, FAQs, and any text you send often.
REUSE CLIPBOARD ITEMS
Keep recent clipboard items within reach and paste them from the Copied keyboard. Auto Save can be turned on or off in Settings. Because iOS controls clipboard access, Copied saves items only when the app, keyboard, or Share extension can access them.
STAY ORGANIZED
Group Keys into folders and pages. Move several Keys at once and keep long lists easy to navigate.
PERSONALIZE AS YOU PASTE
Insert date, time, clipboard, and cursor-position variables into reusable templates.
BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Use a redesigned keyboard with improved layouts, paging, dark mode, and a setup flow that clearly guides you through Keyboard and Paste permissions.
BACKUP AND RESTORE
Back up Keys and folders to your own iCloud account, or export and import them manually.
PRIVACY BY DESIGN
Your Key text, folder names, and clipboard content are not included in Copied's analytics events. Full Access is required by iOS so the app and keyboard can share saved content.
FREE AND PRO
Start free with up to 4 Keys. Copied Pro unlocks unlimited Keys and full productivity features.
Copied offers weekly and annual subscriptions and lifetime purchase options. Prices vary by region and are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID settings.
Terms: https://copiedpro.com/terms
Privacy: https://copiedpro.com/privacy
Support: hello@sharplylabs.com

With iFinance, experience a new and innovative way to view all your Bank Accounts in one place. Review your income and expenses, easily. 
● Unlock rewards & personalised offers:
Earn Reward Points and avail of exclusive offers by conducting transactions or paying utility bills through your Credit Card.
● Customised notifications:
Get updates regarding your bills, Cards, Loans, Bank Accounts and more.

Control access to banking services such as Net Banking, UPI, and Credit and Debit Cards in one swipe. 
● SmartScan

NRI customers can conduct UPI payments with their international mobile number.

apple-macos:6830261737.name: Ease Atelier
apple-macos:6830261737.description:
Ease Atelier tells you how a piece of clothing will fit you before you buy it. Not a size, your actual fit: how much room at the waist and hips, where the hem lands, whether the shoulders are cut narrow.
Enter seven measurements once, with a soft tape or by answering a few questions about what you already wear. Then shop anywhere.
HOW IT WORKS
Paste a link from a shop. Ease reads the piece's own measurements for every size, you pick the size, and you see the fit drawn on your silhouette.
Shopping secondhand? Paste a listing from The RealReal, Depop, Poshmark or Vinted, or add a screenshot, and Ease reads the measurements the seller listed.
See it on you. A figure drawn to your measurements shows where the piece sits, how much room it has and where it ends, in flats or heels.
Straight talk about tailoring. Ease tells you what a tailor can and can't change, and what it would cost.
Ease learns how you like things to fit. Keep a piece, say how it fit, and the next one is judged your way.
MORE
Save pieces, build your closet and see pieces together.
Your own colors, from a short quiz.
Share a fit result with a friend.
Stylists can keep each client's measurements and check any listing for them.
Your measurements are yours. They stay in your account, follow you between your phone and laptop, and are never sold or shared with shops.

*** Named “Most Innovative iPad App of the Year” by Apple App Store ***
LiquidText offers a fast, natural way to review, gather, and organize information across all your documents and webpages—then apply the results to writing reports, meeting prep, or simply studying. Pull out key facts and connect them together, squeeze a document to compare sections, draw a line to connect ideas in different documents, comment on multiple pages at once, build upon your thoughts, and much more.
► WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING:
* "If you want to experience the power of going beyond paper, you can download LiquidText" – Cult of Mac
* One of Macworld’s Top 24 Apps for iPad Pro
* One of Time Magazine's Ten Best apps for iPad Pro *
* "There's a better way to organize your research, and the app is it." – iMore, Serenity Caldwell
* “All you need for deep research projects.” – Macworld, Jackie Dove
* "The world changed with...LiquidText" – Law360, Paul Kiesel
* "LiquidText may just be *the* app for reviewing and annotating PDFs using Apple's tablet and stylus." – CIO Magazine, James Martin
* “One of the most powerful, original iPad apps I've tried in years” – Federico Viticci, MacStories.net
► LIQUIDTEXT’S COMPLETE FEATURE SET INCLUDES:
(Features with * require a paid upgrade.)
Import
• Create a workspace and import all the documents and web pages you need
• Compatible with PDF, Word, and PowerPoint document types
• Import from Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Box, email, and more
• Import content from webpage or send to LiquidText directly from Safari
• Instant OCR to select text in scanned documents; do a full document-OCR to search as well!*
• Import documents & metadata directly from reference managers (supports Zotero and Mendeley)*
Interact
• Pull excerpts from all the documents in your project into the Workspace area
• Add your own notes (typed or written) to the Workspace area
• Freely draw on your notes, or on the workspace itself*
• Organize excerpts and notes into groups
• Connect anything - draw live “ink links” that span pages, documents, notes, and more*
• Create mind-maps by drawing “ink links” connecting your excerpts/notes to one another *
• Get context - tap notes and excerpts to find original source
Compare
• Pinch a document to compare different distant pages side by side
• Collapse text to see annotated parts side-by-side
• Collapse text to view search results(s) side-by-side
• Import unlimited number of documents into a project, view up to 3 at once*
Annotate
• Freely draw* or highlight on your document, notes, or the workspace itself
• Add margin notes/comments to text, images, notes, and excerpts
• Comment on two or more selections simultaneously
• Replace document with a newer version (and annotations are brought to new doc)*
Search
• Search for keywords across all your LiquidText documents
• Find keywords in title or text of your documents*
• Bulk highlight, tag, or link to your search results*
Realtime Collaboration
• Invite colleagues into your shared projects and work together in near realtime*
• Leave comments and notifications for your collaborators*
• Privacy controls: set whether each workspace & document in your project is shared or private*
Easy Export
• Export your project as a PDF (includes your Workspace and documents)
• Export your project as a Word file (converts your notes/excerpts into a linear document) 
• Send a full LiquidText file for those with the app.
• Send files by email or to Dropbox, iCloud Drive, Zotero, and more*
Sync & Backup*
• Real-time, cross-platform sync
• Continuous cloud backup
• Multi-device display: 
• Use your desktop or tablet as additional display for your other device
• Use your tablet for freehand inking while viewing and keyboarding on your desktop
